card.name: Alcohol or dietary intake wording
card.fires_on: The word just before an expected 'intake', 'use' or 'consumed', most often 'alcohol' (or the start of 'Intake') after words like excessive, heavy or moderating. It also fires on 'dietary' and on 'are' before 'consumed'.

modes.label: Alcohol before use/intake
modes.description: The word alcohol, or the start of 'Intake', in phrases about how much alcohol is taken.
modes.example: Excessive Alcohol<< Int>>ake: Alcohol potentiates the effect

modes.label: Dietary or consumed amounts
modes.description: Words that set up a statement about how much of a nutrient or substance is eaten or taken.
modes.example: if their<< dietary>> intake is inadequate; and to take calcium

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning intake or consumption, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say how much of something, especially alcohol, a person takes in.
